items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: INTERVIEWER: The MC, would he make jokes? ... INTERVIEWEE: Yeah, yeah. No, no. Yeah, he'd use his kicks, man.

ctx.x: No, not to that accent or that shit, you know. Yeah. Would they ever make any jokes? Huh?
Would they ever make any jokes? Huh? Make any jokes? Make any jokes. The MC, would he make jokes? Would he be a comic?
